title: Byte's SQL Speed Trial
subtitle: 10 fast SQL questions before the final showdown!
conceptSummary: You've mastered: SELECT/AS, WHERE AND/OR, COUNT/SUM/AVG, GROUP BY, HAVING, DISTINCT, ORDER BY multi-column. One case left!

dialogue.text: Before the boss case, PROVE your SQL skills. 10 questions, 15 seconds each. Let's go!
No peeking at the schema. A real detective knows their tools cold.

task.instruction: 10 quick SQL questions. Pick the right answer before time runs out!

questions.q: To rename a column in output, you use:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city — what does this return?
options: One row per city with customer count

questions.q: ORDER BY salary DESC, name ASC sorts by:
options: Salary highest first, then name A-Z for ties

questions.q: Which query finds customers who spent MORE than 10000 total?
options: HAVING total > 10000 after GROUP BY customer_id

questions.q: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers — if Mumbai appears 5 times, result shows:
The correct ORDER of SQL clauses is:
options: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY

winDialogue.text: SQL Streets conquered! Time for the boss case. SHADOW42's mastermind is within reach!
The final case is big. Use everything you've learned. No half measures.

storyBeat: Your SQL skills are proven. The boss case awaits: a massive cross-database investigation to unmask the SHADOW42 mastermind once and for all.
